title: Extract an element builder from the badge string concatenation
task:
`renderStatusBadge` builds its markup by concatenating strings, so every new attribute is another place escaping can be forgotten.

Extract a small element builder inside `src/render-status-badge.mjs` that takes a tag name, an attribute map and children, and escapes attribute values and text in one place. Rewrite `renderStatusBadge` on top of it.

The rendered output must stay byte-identical: `test/render-status-badge.test.mjs` passes untouched, attribute order does not change, and `escapeHtml` stays exported with its current behaviour. Do not add a dependency and do not introduce a DOM.
